model: H_X = h L + J N_1111(a) + h N_gamma; N_gamma=sum_i(r_i^L+r_i^R); N_1111=sum_i a_i a_{i+1} a_{i+2} a_{i+3}; a_i,b_i,r_i^L,r_i^R in {0,1}; k_B=1
interpretation: h is the proposed energy quantum per emitted radiation bit/contact gap; J is the neighbor-sensitive E4 coupling. The article ADD does not provide a dimensional h. J/h remains a parameter.
ensemble: canonical, fixed graph length L=24; b-sector is a 2^L degeneracy; each vertex has two radiation two-level port bits r_i^L,r_i^R; exact transfer-DP count for N_1111; C is at fixed L, not yet physical C_R

BBN.warning: nu is the physical ADD event density per V T_X^3, not the equilibrium radiation occupation fraction. The model does not derive nu, chi, h/T_X, or V.
